ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity contiguous cluster localized on the distal 40% of the right lobe; secondary fragmented high-intensity mottling on the distal and medial margins of the left lobe; low-intensity pixels dominant in the central fluke regions and leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped notch with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge of both lobes; peak-to-valley amplitudes range from 4 to 18 pixels, with higher density of peaks occurring on the medial sections near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge curvature; trailing edges exhibit a linear trajectory on the distal halves transitioning to a slight concavity near the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clustered high-intensity, roughly circular nodes (calcified barnacles) concentrated on the distal tips and leading edge margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Parallel low-intensity rake marks visible traversing the high-intensity pigmented zone on the distal portion of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on lobe extremities; visible irregular indentation/chip on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct low-intensity circular focal point located within the high-intensity pigmentation field on the distal region of the right lobe.
